text: BAM share rose 1.02 percentage points over 25 hours and 1.06 percentage points over 7 days, to 33.9%. Concentration is elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 22.3% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 63 top-node leadership changes in the window reflect whale-driven routing, not a structural rollover.
